hero.eyebrow: For small agencies — automate repetitive work
hero.headline2: Let Flow handle the repetitive work.
hero.sub: Turn research, reporting, lead follow-up, content operations and repetitive processes into workflows that run automatically—with full visibility.

coreValue.headline: Stop doing it manually. Let it run.
coreValue.body: Every agency has the same 5–10 processes that eat time every week. Flow turns them into workflows that run automatically — so your team works on what only humans can do.
coreValue.exampleRequest: Collect this week's client data, generate a PDF report, email it to the client, and flag any performance drop.

features.headline: Everything your agency needs to automate.
features.sub: Six purpose-built capabilities that work together as one.

agents.title: AI Agents
agents.body: Create specialized AI workers with goals, instructions, tools, memory, and permissions. Your AI team never sleeps.

workflows.title: Workflow Builder
workflows.body: Connect agents, tools, conditions, and triggers. Sequential pipelines, parallel execution, approval gates, and automatic retries.

agentos.title: AgentOS
agentos.body: The command center for your automation. Monitor runs, jobs, and results. Catch errors before they become problems.

gateway.title: AI Gateway
gateway.body: A unified intelligent routing layer. Send every request to the right model for the right task — maximize quality, minimize cost.

memory.title: Memory
memory.body: Give your agents context that persists across workflows. Agents remember what matters, improve over time, and work smarter on every run.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Connect your existing tools and data sources. Flow plugs into your stack — no rebuild required.

howItWorks.headline: From idea to automation in five steps.

steps.title: Describe the process
steps.body: Tell Flow what you want automated. No technical knowledge required.

steps.title: Build the workflow
steps.body: Connect agents, tools, conditions, and approvals. Flow turns your description into an executable workflow.

steps.title: Run it
steps.body: Execute on demand, or trigger automatically on a schedule or event.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.body: Track every run and result in real time. Full visibility, zero surprises.

steps.title: Improve
steps.body: Analyze results, refine your workflow, and deploy improvements. Every run gets smarter.

benefits.headline: Work happens. Even when you're not.

items.title: Reclaim Your Week
items.body: Automate the repetitive work your team does manually every week.

items.title: Focus on High-Value Work
items.body: Let AI handle execution so your team focuses on strategy and clients.

items.title: Deliver More, Hire Less
items.body: Turn manual processes into reliable systems that scale without headcount.

items.title: Full Visibility
items.body: Monitor, approve, and override at every step. You stay in control.

trust.headline: Built for teams that care about security.

items.title: Multi-tenant
items.body: Full organization and team isolation out of the box.

items.title: Role permissions
items.body: Fine-grained access control for every resource.

items.title: Observability
items.body: Full audit trail and real-time monitoring.
